Mieten, Leerstand, Bewirtschaftungskoste: Rents, vacancy, operating costs, condition and location together determine the value an investor will actually pay. GRENFORD models the property the way a buyer would and shows where the upside lies: rent adjustments, extensions, conversion into condominiums or a change of use. The result is set out in the Investment Memo and forms the basis for price and buyer universe. Where the property requires investment, the Renovation Memo provides the capex based on original contractor quotes rather than lump-sum estimates.
Bei Grundstücken und Projektentwicklunge: For plots and development projects, value starts with planning law. Together with architects and valuers from its partner network, GRENFORD reviews possible uses, building volume and an initial cost and revenue calculation. So you know which arguments to bring to talks with developers. For investors, GRENFORD also handles forward deals, i.e. the acquisition of a development project before completion: reviewing construction progress, payment schedule and securities, with financing partners and construction firms from the GRENFORD network on request.
